{
  "summary": "统一草案两属性20项rubric总体通过；登记提案分歧：品牌字段类型（文本vs选项）、多品牌口径、来源冲突是否自动择源、抽片是否条件换算、无品牌声明缺失。17个指定案例意见全部与规则推演一致，其中历史案例仅作演示，不计生产准确率。",
  "checks": [
    {
      "attributeId": "common.brand",
      "criteria": [
        {"criterionId": "relevance", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "三类均挂载，对象限定当前商品自身"},
        {"criterionId": "business_value", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "支持展示搜索筛选，设必填有据"},
        {"criterionId": "semantics", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "排除供应商产地店铺适配，语义单一"},
        {"criterionId": "scope", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "SKU粒度；配件区分自身与适配品牌"},
        {"criterionId": "type_unit", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "选项型无单位，与品牌算子一致；提案文本型分歧已登记"},
        {"criterionId": "requirement", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "未知缺项、无品牌须证据、候选保留，区分清晰"},
        {"criterionId": "enum", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "字典含无品牌项与占位词，候选有升级路径"},
        {"criterionId": "rule", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "前提含语义复核与冲突保留，B02/B04/B05/B08反例覆盖"},
        {"criterionId": "evidence", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "可定位原文且原值须在引用中，仍需独立评审确认自身语义"},
        {"criterionId": "consistency", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "公共定义三类复用一致，无内部矛盾"}
      ]
    },
    {
      "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack",
      "criteria": [
        {"criterionId": "relevance", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "仅挂湿纸巾，内包装片数口径明确"},
        {"criterionId": "business_value", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "展示筛选与比价核心参数，必填合理"},
        {"criterionId": "semantics", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "排除整箱层数抽数均值，语义单一"},
        {"criterionId": "scope", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "SKU级、直接值限inner-pack、推导限同销售范围"},
        {"criterionId": "type_unit", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "数值正整数，单位片/包与算子校验一致"},
        {"criterionId": "requirement", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "缺证据不适用无效混合补证区分明确"},
        {"criterionId": "enum", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "数值型属性，无枚举问题"},
        {"criterionId": "rule", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "不四舍五入不换算冲突保留，Q02至Q17反例覆盖"},
        {"criterionId": "evidence", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "数量须在引用原文，布尔声明须可定位防伪造"},
        {"criterionId": "consistency", "verdict": "pass", "reason": "与既有草稿B69-01一致，单位口径前后统一"}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "findings": [
    {"id": "R2-F01", "attributeId": "common.brand", "severity": "medium", "issue": "方案1、方案2均设品牌为文本型，与统一草案选项型冲突", "recommendation": "裁定字段类型；若采用选项，原文值保留在观察证据层供追溯"},
    {"id": "R2-F02", "attributeId": "common.brand", "severity": "medium", "issue": "联名多品牌口径分歧：方案1填正面主品牌、方案2映射主品牌、草案保留冲突双方证据", "recommendation": "裁定多品牌策略并写入规则，避免多模型口径分裂"},
    {"id": "R2-F03", "attributeId": "common.brand", "severity": "medium", "issue": "方案2主张标题与包装冲突时以包装标识为准自动择源，草案要求不自动挑选来源", "recommendation": "采纳草案保守口径，来源冲突须确认同SKU并裁定后填写"},
    {"id": "R2-F04", "attributeId": "common.brand", "severity": "low", "issue": "方案1缺少明确无品牌声明机制，仅未知留空", "recommendation": "补充无品牌选项及其证据要求，与草案对齐"},
    {"id": "R2-F05", "attributeId": "common.brand", "severity": "low", "issue": "参考字典仅5条且生产ID未核实，真实目录将大量进入enum_candidate", "recommendation": "沿用既有升级路径（复核-抽检-生产字典-重验）并监控候选量"},
    {"id": "R2-F06", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "severity": "medium", "issue": "方案2单位作片而非片/包，且允许80抽=80片条件换算，与草案不换算冲突", "recommendation": "统一单位为片/包，维持本版本不执行抽片换算"},
    {"id": "R2-F07", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "severity": "low", "issue": "混合规格且存在明确inner-pack直接值时，规则一律退回缺证据，可能过度保守", "recommendation": "补充规则：语义确认的直接值可优先，混合仅阻断推导"}
  ],
  "caseOpinions": [
    {"caseId": "Q02", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "filled", "value": 50, "reason": "同范围同规格赠品明确，200÷4=50推导正确"},
    {"caseId": "Q04", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "needs_evidence", "value": null, "reason": "异规格混合禁平均，退回补证正确"},
    {"caseId": "Q05", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "needs_evidence", "value": null, "reason": "赠品排除未声明，推导前提不足"},
    {"caseId": "Q07", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "conflict", "value": null, "reason": "直接50与推导60冲突，保留双方不取舍正确"},
    {"caseId": "Q09", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "needs_evidence", "value": null, "reason": "80抽单位非片，不自动换算正确"},
    {"caseId": "Q15", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "not_applicable", "value": null, "reason": "纸巾盒未挂载本属性，不适用正确"},
    {"caseId": "B02", "attributeId": "common.brand", "status": "needs_evidence", "value": null, "reason": "适配品牌非自身品牌，缺自身证据正确"},
    {"caseId": "B04", "attributeId": "common.brand", "status": "needs_evidence", "value": null, "reason": "国产为占位词非品牌，剔除正确"},
    {"caseId": "B05", "attributeId": "common.brand", "status": "enum_candidate", "value": "示例新品牌", "reason": "证据明确但字典外，保留候选正确"},
    {"caseId": "B08", "attributeId": "common.brand", "status": "filled", "value": "无品牌", "reason": "明确无品牌声明且字典有对应选项，正确"},
    {"caseId": "H01", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "filled", "value": 80, "reason": "标题明示80片/包，演示取值正确"},
    {"caseId": "H03", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "needs_evidence", "value": null, "reason": "无定位观察故缺证据；补60片/包观察可取60"},
    {"caseId": "H04", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "needs_evidence", "value": null, "reason": "80抽非片且无数量观察，缺证据正确"},
    {"caseId": "H06", "attributeId": "common.brand", "status": "enum_candidate", "value": "舒克兔", "reason": "占位国产剔除，标题品牌字典外候选可接受"},
    {"caseId": "H05", "attributeId": "common.brand", "status": "filled", "value": "全棉时代", "reason": "别名全棉时代（PurCotton）精确归一正确"},
    {"caseId": "Q16", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "invalid", "value": null, "reason": "500未出现于引用原文，拒绝伪造正确"},
    {"caseId": "Q17", "attributeId": "wet_wipes.pieces_per_pack", "status": "needs_evidence", "value": null, "reason": "直接值scope为carton非内包装，缺证据正确"}
  ]
}
